reviews.text:
TERRIBLE attitude when they came out to do an estimate for a repair that the owners brother caused while out on a tree trimming job (Stumped tree removal- that's another long frustrating story- but long story short, don't use them either!!!) He said the fix was no big deal and that I was over exaggerating the damage (I recognized it was minor, but wanted it fixed because of the incompetence of his brother's team) and basically flat out told me he didn't want to do the job. Remember this was NOT a voluntary job for me, it was a fix caused by a negligent contractor the day prior. The attitude was condescending, completely unprofessional, and I promptly told them I didn't want them doing ANY work on my house and showed them the way out.

DO NOT USE ALLSTAR GENERAL CONTRACTORS OR STUMPED TREE REMOVAL SERVICES!!!!!
reviews.author: Jamie Pyles

data.summary: The review profile is highly suspicious. The few 5-star reviews appear fake due to duplication and generic content. The single detailed 1-star complaint from 13 years ago reads as authentic and describes unprofessional conduct. The lack of recent reviews and discrepancy with Angi's indicated 2.0 rating suggest the business is not actively receiving genuine customer feedback, and the positive reviews may be fabricated.
fake_signals: Exact duplicate 5-star review text posted by different names (Gabriela Lacy & Anonymous)
Multiple 5-star reviews with identical generic text ('Punctuality, Quality...')
Very low review volume (3-4) over 13+ years
5-star reviews lack specific details and sound promotional
authentic_signals: Detailed, emotionally authentic 1-star complaint with specific scenario
complaint_patterns: Potential connection to poor work from related business
data.discrepancy_explanation: Google shows a 4.0 rating from only 3-4 reviews, but Angi search snippets indicate a 2.0 rating. The Google reviews are old (4-13 years) and show suspicious duplication, while the Angi data suggests a much lower current rating.
